verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's features page documents speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and hands-free voice and video calls, which covers transcription, spoken replies, and live voice conversation. A dedicated STT doc confirms cloud transcription through an OpenAI integration. missing for 10: in-depth docs on TTS and hands-free voice-call behavior beyond a feature-list line, explicit voice-note upload transcription details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
